gaps.assumption: the model's signed flag is an oracle and the note bytes are the signed bytes
gaps.consequence: no claim is made about signature verification, key binding or DER parsing; the differential uses a test-only HMAC-SHA256 key
gaps.gap: DER and signature cryptography are assumed unforgeable
gaps.source: docs/ETP-ADDENDUM-B.md section B.23 (unauthenticated checkpoint clause); docs/LOCAL-TRANSPARENCY.md (test-only HMAC key)

gaps.assumption: each observation carries a monotonically increasing recorded instant
gaps.consequence: backdating is a comparison of records; trusted time, clock skew and RFC 3161 are NOT_RUN
gaps.gap: time is the recorded instant, not a clock

gaps.assumption: a leaf is its bytes; no parsing, DSSE payload or tile structure exists
gaps.consequence: B.23's unrelated-entry, shard, campaign, timestamp and reconstruction clauses are NOT_MODELLED
gaps.gap: the model's leaves are opaque bytes
gaps.source: docs/ETP-ADDENDUM-B.md section B.23 (model paragraph); docs/ARCHIVAL-REVOCATION.md section 2

gaps.assumption: an operation either takes effect atomically or is refused with the state unchanged
gaps.consequence: the B.23 requirement to model crash recovery, retries, partial writes and concurrency is not met; those properties are NOT_RUN
gaps.gap: the model does not model process failure, IO or concurrency
gaps.source: docs/ETP-ADDENDUM-B.md section B.23 (crash recovery, retries, partial writes, concurrent publication and shard transitions are modelled)

gaps.assumption: bound = 5; the reachable state graph is explored, not every sequence executed
gaps.consequence: no claim about a sequence longer than the bound or an alphabet larger than the fourteen operations
gaps.gap: the enumeration is finite and sequence-bounded
gaps.source: docs/ETP-ADDENDUM-B.md section B.23 (bounded model checkers; the abstract model stays small)

gaps.assumption: the model is written from B.23 and the B4/B5/B6 documents, not from the modules
gaps.consequence: agreement is a shared reading, not independent verification; a model theorem is not a proof about the binary (Article 7)
gaps.gap: the model, the checker and the driver share an author
gaps.source: docs/EARNED-TRUST.md Article 5; docs/ETP-ADDENDUM-B.md section B.23 (a verified abstract state machine is not a verified implementation)

limits: The enumeration is finite: the sequence space is bounded at 5 operations over 14 operations.
The state graph is explored, not every sequence executed; the state is complete and the step deterministic, so no sequence's outcome is missed.
A model theorem is not a proof about the binary or the service.
The model shares an author with the implementation.

notRun.item: a witness cosignature admitted from an independent operator

B2 records no timestamp authority in this venue

notRun.item: crash recovery, retries, partial writes and concurrent publication
notRun.reason: not modelled; B.23 requires them and this item does not claim them

notRun.reason: no such tool ran; a model theorem is not a proof about the binary (Article 7)

unmodelled.clause: an unrelated log entry cannot authenticate a DSSE statement;
unmodelled.reason: the model's leaves are opaque bytes; DSSE statements, payload types and the A9/A10 binding are outside it (A23 and A9/A10 own them)

unmodelled.clause: unrelated log shards cannot satisfy a same-tree consistency obligation;
unmodelled.reason: the model has one origin and no shard transitions; cross-shard proof substitution is a tlog/monitor property, exercised by B5's controls

unmodelled.clause: an omitted required campaign activity cannot permit promotion;
unmodelled.reason: campaign opening, amendment and closure are A19/B3 machinery and have no representation in this state

unmodelled.clause: missing timestamp evidence cannot satisfy a timestamp-dependent claim;
unmodelled.reason: the model records an observation instant but has no trusted-time authority or RFC 3161 evidence; B2 records no authority in this venue

unmodelled.clause: unavailable evidence cannot satisfy reconstruction requirements;
unmodelled.reason: archival reconstruction is B6's archive reader; the model has no archive members and no IO
